item.html:
What Are F-Wave™ Synthetic Shingles?

For decades, roofing materials have had the same fundamental weaknesses: asphalt shingles lose their granules, wood shake rots and splits, and real slate is heavy and fragile. F-Wave™ synthetic roofing eliminates all of these problems through modern engineering. Made from a proprietary, commercial-grade polymer mix, F-Wave™ shingles contain absolutely no asphalt, fiberglass, or crushed stone granules.

Instead, they are manufactured as a single-piece, highly durable synthetic material. This means there is nothing to delaminate, nothing to wash away into your gutters, and nothing to crack under the impact of massive hail. Designed to mimic the exact textures and dimensional shadow lines of premium architectural shingles, hand-split wood shake, or natural quarried slate, F-Wave provides Texas homeowners with a luxurious aesthetic that is virtually indestructible.

item.html: Frequently Asked Questions About Synthetic Roofs
item.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Synthetic Roofs

items.q: Do synthetic shingles look fake or shiny?
items.a: Not at all. F-Wave™ uses state-of-the-art manufacturing to create highly authentic textures and varied color profiles. Once installed, it is nearly impossible to tell the difference between F-Wave™ and the natural slate, shake, or premium asphalt it is designed to replicate.

items.q: Will a Class 4 synthetic roof lower my homeowner's insurance?
items.a: In many cases, yes! Because F-Wave™ carries a Class 4 impact rating, many Texas insurance providers offer significant premium discounts to homeowners who install it, as it drastically reduces the likelihood of future hail damage claims.

items.q: Will the color fade in the harsh Texas sun?
items.a: F-Wave™ shingles are manufactured with premium, built-in UV-resistant polymers. Unlike traditional asphalt that can fade or bleach over time, F-Wave™ is designed to maintain its rich, vibrant color for decades.

items.q: Does a synthetic roof require special maintenance?
items.a: One of the biggest advantages of F-Wave™ is that it is virtually maintenance-free. Because there are no granules to replace, no wood to treat for rot, and no fragile slate tiles to replace, you can enjoy your beautiful roof without ongoing upkeep.
